content:
**Abandoned Mine Shaft 6** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*. 

Part of the Hornwright Industrial mining complex at Mount Blair, [Pub 1] this is one of several abandoned and collapsed mine sites.

A metal building is located in the center of this location. To the left of the western door is an Armor Workbench along with an Ammo Box. The center of the building is full of lockers, two searchable chem containers are located at the door and on a bench. The floor has three Mattresses laid on it.

To the west of the building is a broken elevator, to its north is a row of heavy machinery, to the east is a refinery, and to the south is a fusion generator possibly with a lootable Fusion Core.

- Fusion Core - Inside the Fusion Generator south of the Quonset hut.
- Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - Due north in a warehouse beside a green pickup truck east of the tower of the large mining machine.

Abandoned Mine Shaft 6 appears in *Fallout 76*.
